canonical_presence.before: Pen width in pixels for every line. A line that reads well on screen is often too thin once the figure is a column wide.

canonical_presence.before: Every piece of text in the file: the title, the axis labels, the numbers beside the ticks and the legend.

canonical_presence.before: Dots per inch in the written file. 300 is the usual journal minimum; the screen never needs more than about 150.

canonical_presence.before: This figure cannot be previewed, so it will be written exactly as it appears on screen.
canonical_presence.after: This figure cannot be previewed. It will be saved using its current styling, the selected resolution and background transparency, and a tight crop.
